attchmntText: NCL Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026'.
voiceSummary: NCL Industries Limited reported the outcome of its Board meeting held on 12th November, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026. Statutory Auditors issued unmodified Limited Review Reports on these results. The Board also approved the implementation of Phase II and III of the 130 MW Solar and Wind Power Project at Tuticorin, Tamil Nadu. This phase comprises 80 MW at an estimated cost of Rs. 595.17 crores. The aggregate project cost for the entire 130 MW project is Rs. 987.17 crores. Funding will be through a mix of debt and internal accruals. Additionally, the Board granted in-principle approval to approach the Government of Odisha for a proposed Cement Manufacturing Plant. This proposal is at a preliminary stage with no land allotment or binding commitment made yet.

NCL Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: NCL Industries Limited has scheduled an earnings conference call to discuss the unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The call is set for Friday, November 13, 2026, at 04:00 p.m. IST. Management representatives include Vice Chairman and Managing Director Mr. K. Ravi, Executive Director and Chief Financial Officer Mr. N.G.V.S.G. Prasad, Executive Director Mr. Utkal B Goradia, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer Ms. M Divya Bharathi, and Vice President of Finance and Accounts Mr. R Suresh Kumar. The event will be accessible via universal dial-in numbers, international toll-free lines for the USA, UK, Singapore, and Hong Kong, and a Diamond Pass link. Details are also available on the company website at www.nclind.com.
